effects.issue: 'That destroyed card's Standby Phase-activated effect' does not identify which effect to apply when the monster has multiple Standby Phase triggers. Omega also has no API for invoking one arbitrary trigger outside its event while preserving its event data and targeting semantics. Resolution: identify the intended effect by exact text/index or restrict the eligible monsters to an enumerated list, then script those operations; otherwise add a core trigger-invocation API.
